مَهَوَّسٌ Affected with somewhat of madness, or insanity, or diabolical possession. (Ibn-'Abbád, K.) ―
-b2- A man who talks to himself. (A.) ―
-b3- Sometimes, One who is affected with melancholy, and with vain, or unprofitable, suggestions. (TA.) ―
-b4- And One who occupies himself with the science of alchemy. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
